description: DeFAI execution layer on Stellar. Users deploy capital with one command. AI bridges, swaps, routes to best yield. Strategy marketplace for builders.
coreLoop: deposit → chat command → AI executes → yield

tasmilRule.focus: AI-powered autonomous finance protocols, execution layer, yield optimization
tasmilRule.banned: real-world asset tokenization, RWA, asset-backed tokens

features: Strategy Layer: builders create yield strategies, users copy
One-line cross-chain routing: bridge + swap + route in one command
AI execution: understands intent, classifies risk, filters pools
Unified chat interface: no dashboards, no protocol selection
contentAngles: Execution problem (not information problem) — DeFi lacks accessibility
One command deploys capital across chains
Builder-driven growth: turn DeFi research into revenue
DeFAI = default entry point to DeFi for Web2 users

roadmap.P1: May-Jul 2026 — Foundation & PMF: 500-1,000 depositors, $10K-20K routing volume
